items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: Did you know Papa Wayne? No, I didn't know him too good. I didn't know him too well.

ctx.x: I never saw that. I never saw that. I never saw that. I never saw that. It might be the truth now.

Did you know Papa Wayne? No, I didn't know him too good. I didn't know him too well. I knew the Sharky quite well. I'd been in the Sharky and the Blooms that died. He played drama, so he died. I'd been in the formalities here. And Tony Almericka were quite nice, I'd been in there for quite a long time. And Lloyd Cantor, the bass player. Two or three of them. I know his brothers.
Yeah, I know his brothers. Cousins.
